tagline: Homes you want to come back to

listing.description: A website for an interior design studio, furniture brand or decor shop. Window light with leaf shadows in WebGL, project spreads with an object passport, a material palette and per-m² rates.

seo.title: Your Company — interior design for flats and houses in Tashkent
seo.description: A design project from 180,000 UZS per m², design supervision and furnishing. Calm interiors in natural materials for flats and houses in Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is an interior design studio in Tashkent (41 Bobur St). A design project for a flat costs from 180,000 UZS per m² and takes 6–10 weeks, design supervision from 4,000,000 UZS a month, furnishing from 8% of the purchasing budget. The site visit for measurements is free.

sections.title: Interiors where it’s quiet
sections.subtitle: We design flats and houses in natural materials: wood, linen, stone and light. We lead the project from the first measurement to the last vase on the shelf.

sections.label: The studio
sections.title: We don’t design pretty pictures — we design life within the walls
sections.text: First we listen: how you wake up, where you read, how many guests you have on Fridays. Then we work out light, storage and routes through the home — and only then choose materials. We work with local craftspeople: joiners from Fergana, ceramicists from Rishtan, weavers from Margilan. We take on no more than six projects at a time so we can handle each one personally.

items.title: Meeting and measurements
items.text: We visit the site free of charge, take measurements and discuss your lifestyle and budget.

items.title: Layout
items.text: Two or three layout options, furniture placement and lighting.

items.title: Concept
items.text: Collages, materials and visualisations of the key areas.

items.title: Working drawings
items.text: A full set for the builders: electrics, plumbing, wall elevations.

items.title: Supervision and furnishing
items.text: We visit the site, sign off the works, order furniture and lighting.

sections.label: Reviews
sections.title: People write to us a year later

items.quote: A year on, we still notice the little things that were thought through for us: where the umbrella goes, where the morning light falls in the kitchen.
items.author: Irina & Bakhtiyor

items.quote: The studio stayed within the estimate, and when the supplier missed the kitchen deadline they found a joiner in Fergana themselves. We never once went to the site for nothing.
items.author: Shakhnoza

items.q: How much does a design project cost?
items.a: 180,000 UZS per m² for flats and 160,000 UZS per m² for houses over 250 m². A layout only — 60,000 UZS per m². The price is fixed in the contract before work begins.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A layout takes about two weeks; a full design project for a flat takes 6–10 weeks depending on the area and the number of approvals.
We don’t build ourselves, but we work with trusted crews and can lead the project from design to move-in through supervision and furnishing.

items.q: Do you travel out of town for measurements?
items.a: Yes: within Tashkent the visit is free, in Tashkent region it’s free once the contract is signed, otherwise 300,000 UZS.

items.q: Can you include our existing furniture?
items.a: Of course. We photograph and measure the pieces you love and build the project around them.

items.q: How is the project paid for?
items.a: In three parts: 40% on signing the contract, 30% after the concept is approved, 30% on delivery of the drawings.

sections.label: Contacts
sections.title: Tell us about your home
sections.text: Send a floor plan or a couple of photos — we’ll reply within a working day and suggest a time to meet at the studio or on site.
